  37def get_async_engine(db_name: str | None = None, echo: bool = False) -> AsyncEngine:
  38    """Create an async SQLAlchemy engine for the given database.
  39
  40    Uses asyncpg over PostgreSQL with autocommit isolation and connection
  41    pinging.
  42
  43    Args:
  44        db_name: Optional database name; defaults to the configured DB_NAME.
  45        echo: Whether to log SQL statements.
  46
  47    Returns:
  48        AsyncEngine: The configured async engine.
  49    """
  50    database = db_name if db_name else DB_NAME
  51    url = f"postgresql+asyncpg://{DB_USER}:{DB_PASSWORD}@{DB_HOST}:{DB_PORT}/{database}"
  52    return create_async_engine(
  53        url,
  54        echo=echo,
  55        isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT",
  56        pool_pre_ping=True,
  57    )
  58
  59
  60def get_async_session_maker(engine: AsyncEngine) -> async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]:
  61    """Create an async session maker bound to the given engine.
  62
  63    Args:
  64        engine: The async engine to bind.
  65
  66    Returns:
  67        async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession]: A factory for AsyncSession objects.
  68    """
  69    return async_sessionmaker(bind=engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)

  72async def get_db_session(
  73    engine: AsyncEngine,
  74) -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession]:
  75    """Yield a database session as an async context manager.
  76
  77    Args:
  78        engine: The async engine to create the session from.
  79
  80    Yields:
  81        AsyncSession: An open async session.
  82    """
  83    async_session_maker = get_async_session_maker(engine)
  84    async with async_session_maker() as session:
  85        yield session

  88def get_sync_engine(db_name: str | None = None, echo: bool = False):
  89    """Create a synchronous SQLAlchemy engine for the given database.
  90
  91    Uses psycopg over PostgreSQL.
  92
  93    Args:
  94        db_name: Optional database name; defaults to the configured DB_NAME.
  95        echo: Whether to log SQL statements.
  96
  97    Returns:
  98        Engine: The configured sync engine.
  99    """
 100    database = db_name if db_name else DB_NAME
 101    url = f"postgresql+psycopg://{DB_USER}:{DB_PASSWORD}@{DB_HOST}:{DB_PORT}/{database}"
 102    return create_engine(url, echo=echo)

 105async def get_cached_engine(db_name: str | None = None) -> AsyncEngine:
 106    """Return a per-event-loop cached async engine, creating it on first use.
 107
 108    Engines are cached keyed by the running event loop and database name.
 109
 110    Args:
 111        db_name: Optional database name; defaults to the configured DB_NAME.
 112
 113    Returns:
 114        AsyncEngine: The cached async engine.
 115    """
 116    loop_id = id(asyncio.get_running_loop())
 117    key = (loop_id, db_name or "default")
 118    if key not in _engine_cache:
 119        with _cache_lock:
 120            if key not in _engine_cache:
 121                _engine_cache[key] = get_async_engine(db_name=db_name)
 122    return _engine_cache[key]
 123

 125@asynccontextmanager
 126async def get_connection(db_name: str | None = None) -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession]:
 127    """Yield a session from the cached engine as an async context manager.
 128
 129    Args:
 130        db_name: Optional database name; defaults to the configured DB_NAME.
 131
 132    Yields:
 133        AsyncSession: An open async session.
 134    """
 135    engine = await get_cached_engine(db_name)
 136    async_session_maker = get_async_session_maker(engine)
 137    async with async_session_maker() as session:
 138        yield session

 141@asynccontextmanager
 142async def get_transaction(db_name: str | None = None) -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession]:
 143    """Yield a session running inside an explicitly opened transaction.
 144
 145    The application engine runs at ``AUTOCOMMIT`` isolation, where
 146    ``session.begin()`` is a no-op and every statement commits immediately.
 147    This manager issues the transaction control itself (``BEGIN`` /
 148    ``COMMIT`` / ``ROLLBACK``), so the yielded block runs atomically.
 149
 150    Args:
 151        db_name: Optional database name; defaults to the configured DB_NAME.
 152
 153    Yields:
 154        AsyncSession: A session inside an open transaction.
 155    """
 156    async with get_connection(db_name=db_name) as connection:
 157        await connection.execute(text("BEGIN"))
 158        try:
 159            yield connection
 160        except BaseException:
 161            await connection.execute(text("ROLLBACK"))
 162            raise
 163        else:
 164            await connection.execute(text("COMMIT"))
 165

 173async def upsert_pending_session(
 174    task_id: str,
 175    session_id: str | None,
 176    project_id: str | None = None,
 177    user_id: str | None = None,
 178    name: str | None = None,
 179    linear_link: str | None = None,
 180) -> Session:
 181    """Create or update a pending session row for a task.
 182
 183    Inserts a session in the ``initial`` step or, on conflict, refreshes the
 184    mutable fields while preserving the existing step.
 185
 186    Args:
 187        task_id: The Linear task identifier.
 188        session_id: The opencode session id, or None while still pending.
 189        project_id: Optional project id the session belongs to.
 190        user_id: Optional user id the session belongs to.
 191        name: Optional display name for the session.
 192        linear_link: Optional link to the Linear issue.
 193
 194    Returns:
 195        Session: The created or updated session record.
 196
 197    Raises:
 198        BaseException: When the database returns no row.
 199    """
 200    now = datetime.now(UTC)
 201    async with get_connection() as connection:
 202        result = await connection.execute(
 203            text(
 204                """
 205                INSERT INTO sessions (task_id, name, session_id, build_plan, posted_to_linear, step, project_id, user_id, run_attempts, listener_attempts, pr_link, linear_link, created_at, updated_at)
 206                VALUES (:task_id, :name, :session_id, :build_plan, :posted_to_linear, :step, :project_id, :user_id, :run_attempts, :listener_attempts, :pr_link, :linear_link, :created_at, :updated_at)
 207                ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE SET
 208                    name = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.name, ''), sessions.name),
 209                    session_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.session_id, ''), sessions.session_id),
 210                    step = sessions.step,
 211                    project_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.project_id, sessions.project_id),
 212                    user_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_id, sessions.user_id),
 213                    linear_link = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.linear_link, sessions.linear_link),
 214                    updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
 215                RETURNING task_id, name, session_id, build_plan, posted_to_linear, step, project_id, user_id, run_attempts, listener_attempts, pr_link, linear_link, created_at, updated_at
 216                """
 217            ),
 218            {
 219                "task_id": task_id,
 220                "name": name if name else "",
 221                "session_id": session_id if session_id is not None else "",
 222                "build_plan": "",
 223                "posted_to_linear": False,
 224                "step": "initial",
 225                "project_id": project_id,
 226                "user_id": user_id,
 227                "run_attempts": 0,
 228                "listener_attempts": 0,
 229                "pr_link": None,
 230                "linear_link": linear_link,
 231                "created_at": now,
 232                "updated_at": now,
 233            },
 234        )
 235        row = result.fetchone()
 236        await connection.commit()
 237
 238    if row is None:
 239        raise BaseException
 240
 241    return Session(
 242        task_id=row.task_id,
 243        name=row.name,
 244        session_id=row.session_id,
 245        build_plan=row.build_plan,
 246        posted_to_linear=bool(row.posted_to_linear),
 247        step=row.step or "initial",
 248        project_id=row.project_id,
 249        user_id=row.user_id,
 250        run_attempts=row.run_attempts,
 251        listener_attempts=row.listener_attempts,
 252        pr_link=row.pr_link,
 253        linear_link=row.linear_link,
 254        created_at=row.created_at.isoformat(),
 255        updated_at=row.updated_at.isoformat(),
 256    )

 259async def increment_run_attempts(task_id: str) -> int:
 260    """Increment the run attempt counter for a session.
 261
 262    Args:
 263        task_id: The Linear task identifier.
 264
 265    Returns:
 266        int: The updated run attempt count, or 0 when the session is missing.
 267    """
 268    async with get_connection() as connection:
 269        result = await connection.execute(
 270            text(
 271                """
 272                UPDATE sessions
 273                SET run_attempts = run_attempts + 1, updated_at = :updated_at
 274                WHERE task_id = :task_id
 275                RETURNING run_attempts
 276                """
 277            ),
 278            {
 279                "task_id": task_id,
 280                "updated_at": datetime.now(UTC),
 281            },
 282        )
 283        await connection.commit()
 284        row = result.fetchone()
 285    return row.run_attempts if row else 0

 428async def save_session(
 429    task_id: str,
 430    build_plan: str,
 431    name: str | None = None,
 432    session_id: str | None = None,
 433    linear_link: str | None = None,
 434) -> Session:
 435    """Persist a session with its build plan, advancing the step to ``plan``.
 436
 437    Upserts the session row by task id and returns the resulting record.
 438
 439    Args:
 440        task_id: The Linear task identifier.
 441        build_plan: The build plan markdown to store.
 442        name: Optional display name for the session.
 443        session_id: Optional opencode session id.
 444        linear_link: Optional link to the Linear issue.
 445
 446    Returns:
 447        Session: The saved session record.
 448    """
 449    now = datetime.now(UTC)
 450    async with get_connection() as connection:
 451        await connection.execute(
 452            text(
 453                """
 454                INSERT INTO sessions (task_id, name, session_id, build_plan, posted_to_linear, step, project_id, user_id, run_attempts, listener_attempts, pr_link, linear_link, created_at, updated_at)
 455                VALUES (:task_id, :name, :session_id, :build_plan, :posted_to_linear, :step, :project_id, :user_id, :run_attempts, :listener_attempts, :pr_link, :linear_link, :created_at, :updated_at)
 456                ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE SET
 457                    name = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.name, ''), sessions.name),
 458                    session_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.session_id, ''), sessions.session_id),
 459                    build_plan = EXCLUDED.build_plan,
 460                    step = EXCLUDED.step,
 461                    project_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.project_id, sessions.project_id),
 462                    user_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_id, sessions.user_id),
 463                    linear_link = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.linear_link, sessions.linear_link),
 464                    updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
 465                """
 466            ),
 467            {
 468                "task_id": task_id,
 469                "name": name if name else "",
 470                "session_id": session_id if session_id else "",
 471                "build_plan": build_plan,
 472                "posted_to_linear": False,
 473                "step": "plan",
 474                "project_id": None,
 475                "user_id": None,
 476                "run_attempts": 0,
 477                "listener_attempts": 0,
 478                "pr_link": None,
 479                "linear_link": linear_link,
 480                "created_at": now,
 481                "updated_at": now,
 482            },
 483        )
 484        await connection.commit()
 485
 486        result = await connection.execute(select(sessions).where(sessions.c.task_id == task_id))
 487        row = result.fetchone()
 488
 489    if row:
 490        return Session(
 491            task_id=row.task_id,
 492            name=row.name,
 493            session_id=row.session_id,
 494            build_plan=row.build_plan,
 495            posted_to_linear=bool(row.posted_to_linear),
 496            step=row.step or "initial",
 497            project_id=row.project_id,
 498            user_id=row.user_id,
 499            run_attempts=row.run_attempts,
 500            listener_attempts=row.listener_attempts,
 501            pr_link=row.pr_link,
 502            linear_link=row.linear_link,
 503            created_at=row.created_at.isoformat(),
 504            updated_at=row.updated_at.isoformat(),
 505        )
 506
 507    return Session(
 508        task_id=task_id,
 509        name=name,
 510        session_id=session_id,
 511        build_plan=build_plan,
 512        posted_to_linear=False,
 513        step="plan",
 514        project_id=None,
 515        user_id=None,
 516        run_attempts=0,
 517        listener_attempts=0,
 518        pr_link=None,
 519        linear_link=linear_link,
 520        created_at=now.isoformat(),
 521        updated_at=now.isoformat(),
 522    )

 591async def get_sessions(user_id: str, step: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
 592    """List sessions for a user, optionally filtered by current step.
 593
 594    Sessions are returned newest first.
 595
 596    Args:
 597        user_id: The user id to scope the query to.
 598        step: Optional step name to filter on.
 599
 600    Returns:
 601        list[dict]: The matching session rows.
 602    """
 603    query = select(sessions).where(sessions.c.user_id == user_id)
 604    if step is not None:
 605        query = query.where(sessions.c.step == step)
 606
 607    query = query.order_by(sessions.c.created_at.desc())
 608
 609    async with get_connection() as connection:
 610        result = await connection.execute(query)
 611        rows = result.fetchall()
 612
 613    return [dict(row._mapping) for row in rows]

 616async def save_oauth_token(service: str, access_token: str, refresh_token: str | None, expires_in: int) -> None:
 617    """Store or refresh an OAuth access token for a service.
 618
 619    Args:
 620        service: The service identifier, e.g. ``"linear"``.
 621        access_token: The access token to store.
 622        refresh_token: Optional refresh token for the service.
 623        expires_in: Token lifetime in seconds from now.
 624    """
 625    expires_at = datetime.fromtimestamp(datetime.now(UTC).timestamp() + expires_in, tz=UTC)
 626    async with get_connection() as connection:
 627        if refresh_token is not None:
 628            await connection.execute(
 629                text(
 630                    """
 631                    INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (service, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at)
 632                    VALUES (:service, :access_token, :refresh_token, :expires_at)
 633                    ON CONFLICT (service) DO UPDATE SET
 634                        access_token = EXCLUDED.access_token,
 635                        refresh_token = EXCLUDED.refresh_token,
 636                        expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
 637                    """
 638                ),
 639                {
 640                    "service": service,
 641                    "access_token": access_token,
 642                    "refresh_token": refresh_token,
 643                    "expires_at": expires_at,
 644                },
 645            )
 646        else:
 647            await connection.execute(
 648                text(
 649                    """
 650                    INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (service, access_token, expires_at)
 651                    VALUES (:service, :access_token, :expires_at)
 652                    ON CONFLICT (service) DO UPDATE SET
 653                        access_token = EXCLUDED.access_token,
 654                        expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
 655                    """
 656                ),
 657                {
 658                    "service": service,
 659                    "access_token": access_token,
 660                    "expires_at": expires_at,
 661                },
 662            )
 663        await connection.commit()
 664
 665
 666async def get_oauth_token(service: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
 667    """Return a non-expired stored OAuth token for a service.
 668
 669    Args:
 670        service: The service identifier.
 671
 672    Returns:
 673        tuple[str, str] | None: The access token and its expiry timestamp, or
 674            None when absent or expired.
 675    """
 676    async with get_connection() as connection:
 677        result = await connection.execute(select(oauth_tokens).where(oauth_tokens.c.service == service))
 678        row = result.fetchone()
 679
 680    if not row:
 681        return None
 682
 683    expires_at = row.expires_at.timestamp()
 684    if datetime.now(UTC).timestamp() < expires_at:
 685        return row.access_token, str(expires_at)

 724async def record_session_history(
 725    session_id: str,
 726    step: str,
 727    length: int | None = None,
 728    input_tokens: int | None = None,
 729    output_tokens: int | None = None,
 730    reasoning_tokens: int | None = None,
 731    cache_read_tokens: int | None = None,
 732    cache_write_tokens: int | None = None,
 733    context_tokens: int | None = None,
 734    model: str | None = None,
 735) -> SessionHistory:
 736    """Record an opencode session's token usage at a workflow step.
 737
 738    Args:
 739        session_id: The opencode session id.
 740        step: The workflow step name.
 741        length: Optional message length in characters.
 742        input_tokens: Optional input token count.
 743        output_tokens: Optional output token count.
 744        reasoning_tokens: Optional reasoning token count.
 745        cache_read_tokens: Optional cache read token count.
 746        cache_write_tokens: Optional cache write token count.
 747        context_tokens: Optional context window token count.
 748        model: Optional model identifier.
 749
 750    Returns:
 751        SessionHistory: The persisted history record.
 752    """
 753    history_id = str(uuid4())
 754    now = datetime.now(UTC)
 755    async with get_connection() as connection:
 756        await connection.execute(
 757            insert(session_history).values(
 758                id=history_id,
 759                session_id=session_id,
 760                step=step,
 761                length=length,
 762                input_tokens=input_tokens,
 763                output_tokens=output_tokens,
 764                reasoning_tokens=reasoning_tokens,
 765                cache_read_tokens=cache_read_tokens,
 766                cache_write_tokens=cache_write_tokens,
 767                context_tokens=context_tokens,
 768                model=model,
 769                created_at=now,
 770            )
 771        )
 772        await connection.commit()
 773
 774    return SessionHistory(
 775        id=history_id,
 776        session_id=session_id,
 777        step=step,
 778        length=length,
 779        input_tokens=input_tokens,
 780        output_tokens=output_tokens,
 781        reasoning_tokens=reasoning_tokens,
 782        cache_read_tokens=cache_read_tokens,
 783        cache_write_tokens=cache_write_tokens,
 784        context_tokens=context_tokens,
 785        model=model,
 786        created_at=now.isoformat(),
 787    )

 980) -> str:
 981    """Create a new allowlist entry and return its id.

1002        created_at=now,

1006        async with get_connection() as conn:
1007            await conn.execute(statement)
1008            await conn.commit()
1009        return entry_id
1010    await connection.execute(statement)
1011    return entry_id

1063

1065    for row in rows:
1066        seed_rows.append({"entry_type": "email", "value": row.email, "source_user_id": row.id})
1067        seed_rows.append({"entry_type": "github_username", "value": row.github_username, "source_user_id": row.id})
1068    return seed_rows

1135async def update_waitlist_entry(
1136    entry_id: str,
1137    changes: WaitlistEntryUpdate,
1138    connection: AsyncSession | None = None,
1139) -> bool:
1140    """Apply a status transition to a waitlist entry by id.
1141
1142    ``updated_at`` is always bumped. Fields left as None on the update keep
1143    their current column value; ``clear_approval`` resets the approval
1144    metadata columns to NULL.
1145
1146    Args:
1147        entry_id: The waitlist entry id.
1148        changes: The status transition and column changes to apply.
1149        connection: An optional shared connection to run within; when omitted
1150            a new connection is opened and the change is committed.
1151
1152    Returns:
1153        bool: True when a row was updated, False when none matched.
1154    """
1155    values: dict = {"updated_at": datetime.now(UTC), "status": changes.status}
1156    if changes.approved_by is not None:
1157        values["approved_by"] = changes.approved_by
1158    if changes.approved_at is not None:
1159        values["approved_at"] = changes.approved_at
1160    if changes.notified_at is not None:
1161        values["notified_at"] = changes.notified_at
1162    if changes.joined_at is not None:
1163        values["joined_at"] = changes.joined_at
1164    if changes.clear_approval:
1165        values.update(approved_by=None, approved_at=None, notified_at=None, joined_at=None)
1166
1167    statement = (
1168        update(waitlist_entries)
1169        .where(waitlist_entries.c.id == entry_id)
1170        .values(**values)
1171        .returning(waitlist_entries.c.id)
1172    )
1173    if connection is None:
1174        async with get_connection() as conn:
1175            result = await conn.execute(statement)
1176            row = result.fetchone()
1177            await conn.commit()
1178        return row is not None
1179    result = await connection.execute(statement)
1180    row = result.fetchone()
1181    return row is not None
1182

1221async def save_jwt_token(token: str, user_id: str, expires_at: str) -> None:
1222    """Persist a JWT session record for a user.
1223
1224    The stored ``password_version`` is read from the user row at issuance, so
1225    any token minted before a password reset carries the old version and is
1226    rejected by :func:`verify_jwt_token` after the reset commits.
1227
1228    Args:
1229        token: The JWT to store.
1230        user_id: The user id the token belongs to.
1231        expires_at: ISO-8601 expiry timestamp.
1232
1233    Raises:
1234        RuntimeError: When no user row exists for the id.
1235    """
1236    now = datetime.now(UTC)
1237    expires_at_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(expires_at)
1238
1239    async with get_connection() as connection:
1240        version_result = await connection.execute(
1241            text("SELECT password_version FROM users WHERE id = :user_id"),
1242            {"user_id": user_id},
1243        )
1244        version_row = version_result.fetchone()
1245        if version_row is None:
1246            raise RuntimeError(f"User {user_id} not found while saving JWT session")
1247
1248        await connection.execute(
1249            text(
1250                """
1251                INSERT INTO jwt_tokens (token, user_id, expires_at, created_at, password_version)
1252                VALUES (:token, :user_id, :expires_at, :created_at, :password_version)
1253                ON CONFLICT (token) DO NOTHING
1254                """
1255            ),
1256            {
1257                "token": token,
1258                "user_id": user_id,
1259                "expires_at": expires_at_dt,
1260                "created_at": now,
1261                "password_version": version_row[0],
1262            },
1263        )
1264        await connection.commit()
1265

1297async def delete_jwt_token(token: str, connection: AsyncSession | None = None) -> None:
1298    """Delete a stored JWT session record, revoking the token.
1299
1300    Args:
1301        token: The JWT to revoke.
1302        connection: An optional shared connection to run within; when omitted
1303            a new connection is opened and the change is committed.
1304    """
1305    statement = delete(jwt_tokens).where(jwt_tokens.c.token == token)
1306    if connection is None:
1307        async with get_connection() as conn:
1308            await conn.execute(statement)
1309            await conn.commit()
1310        return
1311    await connection.execute(statement)

1329async def update_user_password(
1330    user_id: str,
1331    password_hash: str,
1332    connection: AsyncSession | None = None,
1333) -> None:
1334    """Replace the stored password hash for a user, invalidating prior sessions.
1335
1336    Bumps ``password_version`` so every JWT minted before the change is
1337    rejected by :func:`verify_jwt_token`.
1338
1339    Args:
1340        user_id: The user id.
1341        password_hash: The new password hash.
1342        connection: An optional shared connection to run within; when omitted
1343            a new connection is opened and the change is committed.
1344    """
1345    statement = (
1346        users.update()
1347        .where(users.c.id == user_id)
1348        .values(password_hash=password_hash, password_version=users.c.password_version + 1)
1349    )
1350    if connection is None:
1351        async with get_connection() as conn:
1352            await conn.execute(statement)
1353            await conn.commit()
1354        return
1355    await connection.execute(statement)

1358async def create_project(
1359    user_id: str,
1360    name: str,
1361    repository_url: str,
1362    repository_owner: str,
1363    repository_name: str,
1364    linear_project_id: str | None = None,
1365    local_path: str | None = None,
1366    state: str = "provisioning",
1367) -> dict:
1368    """Create a project record and return its row as a dict.
1369
1370    Args:
1371        user_id: The owning user id.
1372        name: The project display name.
1373        repository_url: The repository clone URL.
1374        repository_owner: The repository owner.
1375        repository_name: The repository name.
1376        linear_project_id: Optional linked Linear project id.
1377        local_path: Optional local checkout path.
1378        state: Initial project state, defaulting to ``"provisioning"``.

1380    Returns:

1395                repository_owner=repository_owner,
1396                local_path=local_path,

1398                created_at=now,
1399                updated_at=now,

1402        await connection.commit()
1403
1404    return {
1405        "id": project_id,
1406        "user_id": user_id,
1407        "linear_project_id": linear_project_id,

1482async def update_project(
1483    project_id: str,
1484    user_id: str,
1485    linear_project_id: str | None = None,
1486    name: str | None = None,
1487    repository_url: str | None = None,
1488    local_path: str | None = None,
1489    state: str | None = None,
1490) -> dict | None:
1491    """Update mutable fields of a user-scoped project.
1492
1493    Only non-None fields are updated; the record must belong to the given
1494    user.
1495
1496    Args:
1497        project_id: The project id.
1498        user_id: The owning user id.
1499        linear_project_id: Optional new Linear project link.
1500        name: Optional new project name.
1501        repository_url: Optional new repository URL.
1502        local_path: Optional new local checkout path.
1503        state: Optional new project state.
1504
1505    Returns:
1506        dict | None: The updated project row, or None when not found.
1507    """
1508    now = datetime.now(UTC)
1509    update_values: dict[str, datetime | str] = {"updated_at": now}
1510
1511    if linear_project_id is not None:
1512        update_values["linear_project_id"] = linear_project_id
1513
1514    if name is not None:
1515        update_values["name"] = name
1516
1517    if repository_url is not None:
1518        update_values["repository_url"] = repository_url
1519
1520    if local_path is not None:
1521        update_values["local_path"] = local_path
1522
1523    if state is not None:
1524        update_values["state"] = state
1525
1526    async with get_connection() as connection:
1527        await connection.execute(
1528            projects.update()
1529            .where((projects.c.id == project_id) & (projects.c.user_id == user_id))
1530            .values(**update_values)
1531        )
1532        await connection.commit()
1533
1534        result = await connection.execute(
1535            select(projects).where((projects.c.id == project_id) & (projects.c.user_id == user_id))
1536        )
1537        row = result.fetchone()
1538    return dict(row._mapping) if row else None

1541async def get_project_environments(project_id: str, user_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
1542    """Return the decrypted environment variables of a project.
1543
1544    Encrypted values are decrypted on read; failures yield an empty value.
1545    Only rows scoped to ``"project"`` are returned; user-shared rows are
1546    resolved separately via :func:`get_user_environments_decrypted`.
1547
1548    Args:
1549        project_id: The project id.
1550        user_id: Optional user id for ownership verification.
1551
1552    Returns:
1553        dict[str, str]: The environment as a key-value mapping.
1554
1555    Raises:
1556        LookupError: When a user is given and the project is not owned by them.
1557    """
1558    from demetra.services.persistence.encryption import decrypt_str
1559
1560    if user_id and not await get_project_by_id(project_id=project_id, user_id=user_id):
1561        raise LookupError("Project not found")
1562
1563    async with get_connection() as connection:
1564        result = await connection.execute(
1565            select(project_environments).where(
1566                (project_environments.c.project_id == project_id) & (project_environments.c.scope == "project")
1567            )
1568        )
1569        rows = result.fetchall()
1570
1571    env: dict[str, str] = {}
1572    for row in rows:
1573        if row.type == "encrypted":
1574            try:
1575                env[row.key] = decrypt_str(row.value)
1576            except ValueError:
1577                logger.exception("Failed to decrypt env var '%s' for project '%s'", row.key, project_id)
1578                env[row.key] = ""
1579        else:
1580            env[row.key] = row.value
1581    return env
1582

1624async def _fetch_stored_encrypted_value(owner_column: Column, owner_id: str, scope: str, keys: list[str]) -> str | None:
1625    """Return the stored ciphertext of an existing encrypted row among ``keys``.
1626
1627    Keys are tried in order, so callers list the current key first and the
1628    previous (pre-rename) key second.
1629
1630    Args:
1631        owner_column: The owner column (``project_id`` or ``user_id``).
1632        owner_id: The owner id to match.
1633        scope: ``"project"`` or ``"user"``.
1634        keys: Candidate environment variable names, in preference order.
1635
1636    Returns:
1637        str | None: The stored encrypted value, or None when no candidate
1638            row is encrypted.
1639    """
1640    async with get_connection() as connection:
1641        result = await connection.execute(
1642            select(project_environments.c.key, project_environments.c.value, project_environments.c.type).where(
1643                (owner_column == owner_id)
1644                & (project_environments.c.key.in_(keys))
1645                & (project_environments.c.scope == scope)
1646            )
1647        )
1648        rows = {row.key: row for row in result.fetchall()}
1649    for key in keys:
1650        row = rows.get(key)
1651        if row is not None and row.type == "encrypted":
1652            return row.value
1653    return None
1654
1655
1656async def _resolve_encrypted_env_value(
1657    *,
1658    key: str,
1659    value: str,
1660    previous_key: str | None,
1661    owner_column: Column,
1662    owner_id: str,
1663    scope: str,
1664) -> str:
1665    """Return the ciphertext to store for an encrypted environment variable.
1666
1667    A non-blank ``value`` is encrypted fresh; a blank one reuses the stored
1668    ciphertext of the row under ``key`` or ``previous_key``, so editing or
1669    renaming an encrypted variable without re-entering the secret preserves
1670    it. Falls back to encrypting the blank value when no encrypted row exists.
1671
1672    Args:
1673        key: The environment variable name.
1674        value: The new plaintext value, possibly blank.
1675        previous_key: Optional prior key when renaming an existing entry.
1676        owner_column: The owner column (``project_id`` or ``user_id``).
1677        owner_id: The owner id to match.
1678        scope: ``"project"`` or ``"user"``.
1679
1680    Returns:
1681        str: The ciphertext to store.
1682    """
1683    from demetra.services.persistence.encryption import encrypt_str
1684
1685    if value.strip():
1686        return encrypt_str(plaintext=value)
1687    keys = [key]
1688    if previous_key and previous_key != key:
1689        keys.append(previous_key)
1690    stored = await _fetch_stored_encrypted_value(owner_column=owner_column, owner_id=owner_id, scope=scope, keys=keys)
1691    return stored if stored is not None else encrypt_str(plaintext=value)
1692
1693
1694async def _delete_previous_environment_key(
1695    connection: AsyncSession,
1696    *,
1697    owner_column: Column,
1698    owner_id: str,
1699    key: str,
1700    previous_key: str | None,
1701    scope: str,
1702) -> None:
1703    """Delete the old row after an environment variable rename.
1704
1705    No-op when the rename carries no previous key or it matches the new key.
1706
1707    Args:
1708        connection: An open transaction to run the delete within.
1709        owner_column: The owner column (``project_id`` or ``user_id``).
1710        owner_id: The owner id to match.
1711        key: The new environment variable name.
1712        previous_key: Optional prior key when renaming an existing entry.
1713        scope: ``"project"`` or ``"user"``.
1714    """
1715    if not previous_key or previous_key == key:
1716        return
1717    await connection.execute(
1718        delete(project_environments).where(
1719            (owner_column == owner_id)
1720            & (project_environments.c.key == previous_key)
1721            & (project_environments.c.scope == scope)
1722        )
1723    )
1724
1725
1726async def upsert_project_environment(
1727    project_id: str,
1728    user_id: str,
1729    key: str,
1730    value: str,
1731    env_type: str = "text",
1732    previous_key: str | None = None,
1733) -> dict:
1734    """Create or update a project environment variable.
1735
1736    Encrypted values are encrypted before storage. When ``value`` is blank
1737    the stored ciphertext of the row under ``key`` or ``previous_key`` is
1738    reused, so editing or renaming an encrypted variable without re-entering
1739    the secret preserves it. The row is scoped to ``"project"``.
1740
1741    Args:
1742        project_id: The project id.
1743        user_id: The owning user id for verification.
1744        key: The environment variable name.
1745        value: The environment variable value.
1746        env_type: ``"text"`` or ``"encrypted"``.
1747        previous_key: Optional prior key when renaming an existing entry.
1748
1749    Returns:
1750        dict: The created or updated entry with the value masked when
1751            encrypted.
1752
1753    Raises:
1754        LookupError: When the project is not owned by the user.
1755        RuntimeError: When the database returns no row.
1756    """
1757    from uuid import uuid4
1758
1759    from demetra.library.models import ENCRYPTED_VALUE_MASK
1760
1761    if not await get_project_by_id(project_id=project_id, user_id=user_id):
1762        raise LookupError("Project not found")
1763
1764    stored_value: str
1765    if env_type == "encrypted":
1766        stored_value = await _resolve_encrypted_env_value(
1767            key=key,
1768            value=value,
1769            previous_key=previous_key,
1770            owner_column=project_environments.c.project_id,
1771            owner_id=project_id,
1772            scope="project",
1773        )
1774    else:
1775        stored_value = value
1776
1777    async with get_transaction() as connection:
1778        result = await connection.execute(
1779            text(
1780                """
1781                INSERT INTO project_environment (id, project_id, key, value, type, scope)
1782                VALUES (:id, :project_id, :key, :value, :type, 'project')
1783                ON CONFLICT (project_id, key) WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET
1784                    value = EXCLUDED.value,
1785                    type = EXCLUDED.type
1786                RETURNING id, type
1787                """
1788            ),
1789            {
1790                "id": str(uuid4()),
1791                "project_id": project_id,
1792                "key": key,
1793                "value": stored_value,
1794                "type": env_type,
1795            },
1796        )
1797        row = result.fetchone()
1798        await _delete_previous_environment_key(
1799            connection=connection,
1800            owner_column=project_environments.c.project_id,
1801            owner_id=project_id,
1802            key=key,
1803            previous_key=previous_key,
1804            scope="project",
1805        )
1806
1807    if row is None:
1808        raise RuntimeError("Failed to insert project environment")
1809
1810    return {
1811        "id": row.id,
1812        "project_id": project_id,
1813        "key": key,
1814        "value": ENCRYPTED_VALUE_MASK if env_type == "encrypted" else value,
1815        "type": row.type,
1816    }
1817
1818

1913async def upsert_user_environment(
1914    user_id: str,
1915    key: str,
1916    value: str,
1917    env_type: str = "text",
1918    previous_key: str | None = None,
1919) -> dict:
1920    """Create or update a user-shared environment variable.
1921
1922    Encrypted values are encrypted before storage. When ``value`` is blank
1923    the stored ciphertext of the row under ``key`` or ``previous_key`` is
1924    reused, so editing or renaming an encrypted variable without re-entering
1925    the secret preserves it. The row is scoped to ``"user"`` with no project
1926    link.
1927
1928    Args:
1929        user_id: The user id.
1930        key: The environment variable name.
1931        value: The environment variable value.
1932        env_type: ``"text"`` or ``"encrypted"``.
1933        previous_key: Optional prior key when renaming an existing entry.
1934
1935    Returns:
1936        dict: The created or updated entry with the value masked when
1937            encrypted.
1938
1939    Raises:
1940        LookupError: When the user does not exist.
1941        RuntimeError: When the database returns no row.
1942    """
1943    from uuid import uuid4
1944
1945    from demetra.library.models import ENCRYPTED_VALUE_MASK, is_sensitive_key
1946
1947    if not await get_user_by_id(user_id=user_id):
1948        raise LookupError("User not found")
1949
1950    stored_value: str
1951    if env_type == "encrypted":
1952        stored_value = await _resolve_encrypted_env_value(
1953            key=key,
1954            value=value,
1955            previous_key=previous_key,
1956            owner_column=project_environments.c.user_id,
1957            owner_id=user_id,
1958            scope="user",
1959        )
1960    else:
1961        stored_value = value
1962
1963    async with get_transaction() as connection:
1964        result = await connection.execute(
1965            text(
1966                """
1967                INSERT INTO project_environment (id, user_id, key, value, type, scope)
1968                VALUES (:id, :user_id, :key, :value, :type, 'user')
1969                ON CONFLICT (user_id, key) WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET
1970                    value = EXCLUDED.value,
1971                    type = EXCLUDED.type
1972                RETURNING id, type
1973                """
1974            ),
1975            {
1976                "id": str(uuid4()),
1977                "user_id": user_id,
1978                "key": key,
1979                "value": stored_value,
1980                "type": env_type,
1981            },
1982        )
1983        row = result.fetchone()
1984        await _delete_previous_environment_key(
1985            connection=connection,
1986            owner_column=project_environments.c.user_id,
1987            owner_id=user_id,
1988            key=key,
1989            previous_key=previous_key,
1990            scope="user",
1991        )
1992
1993    if row is None:
1994        raise RuntimeError("Failed to insert user environment")
1995
1996    return {
1997        "id": row.id,
1998        "user_id": user_id,
1999        "key": key,
2000        "value": ENCRYPTED_VALUE_MASK if env_type == "encrypted" or is_sensitive_key(key) else value,
2001        "type": row.type,
2002    }
2003

2008    Args:

2012    Raises:

2029async def delete_project(project_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool:
2030    """Delete a user-scoped project together with its environment entries.
2031
2032    Args:
2033        project_id: The project id.
2034        user_id: The owning user id.
2035
2036    Returns:
2037        bool: True when the project was deleted, False when it did not exist.
2038    """
2039    async with get_transaction() as connection:
2040        existing = await connection.execute(
2041            select(projects.c.id).where((projects.c.id == project_id) & (projects.c.user_id == user_id))
2042        )
2043        if not existing.fetchone():
2044            return False
2045        await connection.execute(delete(project_environments).where(project_environments.c.project_id == project_id))
2046        await connection.execute(
2047            delete(projects).where((projects.c.id == project_id) & (projects.c.user_id == user_id))
2048        )
2049    return True

2052async def delete_session(task_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool:
2053    """Delete a user-scoped session and its log file.
2054
2055    Args:
2056        task_id: The Linear task identifier.
2057        user_id: The owning user id.
2058
2059    Returns:
2060        bool: True when the session existed and was deleted, otherwise False.
2061    """
2062    from demetra.settings import LOG_DIR
2063
2064    if not SAFE_TASK_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(task_id):
2065        return False
2066
2067    async with get_connection() as connection:
2068        result = await connection.execute(
2069            delete(sessions)
2070            .where((sessions.c.task_id == task_id) & (sessions.c.user_id == user_id))
2071            .returning(sessions.c.task_id)
2072        )
2073        row = result.fetchone()
2074        await connection.commit()
2075        if not row:
2076            return False
2077
2078    sessions_log_dir = (LOG_DIR / "sessions").resolve()
2079    log_path = (sessions_log_dir / f"{task_id}.log").resolve()
2080    try:
2081        log_path.relative_to(sessions_log_dir)
2082    except ValueError:
2083        return True
2084
2085    if log_path.exists():
2086        try:
2087            log_path.unlink()
2088        except OSError:
2089            pass
2090
2091    return True

38def get_async_engine(db_name: str | None = None, echo: bool = False) -> AsyncEngine:

41    Uses asyncpg over PostgreSQL with autocommit isolation and connection

54        url,
55        echo=echo,
56        isolation_level="AUTOCOMMIT",
57        pool_pre_ping=True,
58    )

async def get_cached_engine(db_name: str | None = None) -> sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio.engine.AsyncEngine: 
106async def get_cached_engine(db_name: str | None = None) -> AsyncEngine:
107    """Return a per-event-loop cached async engine, creating it on first use.
108
109    Engines are cached keyed by the running event loop and database name.
110
111    Args:
112        db_name: Optional database name; defaults to the configured DB_NAME.
113
114    Returns:
115        AsyncEngine: The cached async engine.
116    """
117    loop_id = id(asyncio.get_running_loop())
118    key = (loop_id, db_name or "default")
119    if key not in _engine_cache:
120        with _cache_lock:
121            if key not in _engine_cache:
122                _engine_cache[key] = get_async_engine(db_name=db_name)
123    return _engine_cache[key]

126@asynccontextmanager
127async def get_connection(db_name: str | None = None) -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession]:
128    """Yield a session from the cached engine as an async context manager.
129
130    Args:
131        db_name: Optional database name; defaults to the configured DB_NAME.
132
133    Yields:
134        AsyncSession: An open async session.
135    """
136    engine = await get_cached_engine(db_name)
137    async_session_maker = get_async_session_maker(engine)
138    async with async_session_maker() as session:
139        yield session

@asynccontextmanager
async def get_transaction( db_name: str | None = None) -> AsyncGenerator[sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio.session.AsyncSession]: 
142@asynccontextmanager
143async def get_transaction(db_name: str | None = None) -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession]:
144    """Yield a session running inside an explicitly opened transaction.
145
146    The application engine runs at ``AUTOCOMMIT`` isolation, where
147    ``session.begin()`` is a no-op and every statement commits immediately.
148    This manager issues the transaction control itself (``BEGIN`` /
149    ``COMMIT`` / ``ROLLBACK``), so the yielded block runs atomically.
150
151    Args:
152        db_name: Optional database name; defaults to the configured DB_NAME.
153
154    Yields:
155        AsyncSession: A session inside an open transaction.
156    """
157    async with get_connection(db_name=db_name) as connection:
158        await connection.execute(text("BEGIN"))
159        try:
160            yield connection
161        except BaseException:
162            await connection.execute(text("ROLLBACK"))
163            raise
164        else:
165            await connection.execute(text("COMMIT"))

Args: db_name: Optional database name; defaults to the configured DB_NAME.

Yields: AsyncSession: A session inside an open transaction.

async def upsert_pending_session( task_id: str, session_id: str | None, project_id: str | None = None, user_id: str | None = None, name: str | None = None, linear_link: str | None = None) -> demetra.library.models.Session: 
174async def upsert_pending_session(
175    task_id: str,
176    session_id: str | None,
177    project_id: str | None = None,
178    user_id: str | None = None,
179    name: str | None = None,
180    linear_link: str | None = None,
181) -> Session:
182    """Create or update a pending session row for a task.
183
184    Inserts a session in the ``initial`` step or, on conflict, refreshes the
185    mutable fields while preserving the existing step.
186
187    Args:
188        task_id: The Linear task identifier.
189        session_id: The opencode session id, or None while still pending.
190        project_id: Optional project id the session belongs to.
191        user_id: Optional user id the session belongs to.
192        name: Optional display name for the session.
193        linear_link: Optional link to the Linear issue.
194
195    Returns:
196        Session: The created or updated session record.
197
198    Raises:
199        BaseException: When the database returns no row.
200    """
201    now = datetime.now(UTC)
202    async with get_connection() as connection:
203        result = await connection.execute(
204            text(
205                """
206                INSERT INTO sessions (task_id, name, session_id, build_plan, posted_to_linear, step, project_id, user_id, run_attempts, listener_attempts, pr_link, linear_link, created_at, updated_at)
207                VALUES (:task_id, :name, :session_id, :build_plan, :posted_to_linear, :step, :project_id, :user_id, :run_attempts, :listener_attempts, :pr_link, :linear_link, :created_at, :updated_at)
208                ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE SET
209                    name = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.name, ''), sessions.name),
210                    session_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.session_id, ''), sessions.session_id),
211                    step = sessions.step,
212                    project_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.project_id, sessions.project_id),
213                    user_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_id, sessions.user_id),
214                    linear_link = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.linear_link, sessions.linear_link),
215                    updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
216                RETURNING task_id, name, session_id, build_plan, posted_to_linear, step, project_id, user_id, run_attempts, listener_attempts, pr_link, linear_link, created_at, updated_at
217                """
218            ),
219            {
220                "task_id": task_id,
221                "name": name if name else "",
222                "session_id": session_id if session_id is not None else "",
223                "build_plan": "",
224                "posted_to_linear": False,
225                "step": "initial",
226                "project_id": project_id,
227                "user_id": user_id,
228                "run_attempts": 0,
229                "listener_attempts": 0,
230                "pr_link": None,
231                "linear_link": linear_link,
232                "created_at": now,
233                "updated_at": now,
234            },
235        )
236        row = result.fetchone()
237        await connection.commit()
238
239    if row is None:
240        raise BaseException
241
242    return Session(
243        task_id=row.task_id,
244        name=row.name,
245        session_id=row.session_id,
246        build_plan=row.build_plan,
247        posted_to_linear=bool(row.posted_to_linear),
248        step=row.step or "initial",
249        project_id=row.project_id,
250        user_id=row.user_id,
251        run_attempts=row.run_attempts,
252        listener_attempts=row.listener_attempts,
253        pr_link=row.pr_link,
254        linear_link=row.linear_link,
255        created_at=row.created_at.isoformat(),
256        updated_at=row.updated_at.isoformat(),
257    )

430    task_id: str,
431    build_plan: str,
432    name: str | None = None,
433    session_id: str | None = None,
434    linear_link: str | None = None,
435) -> Session:
436    """Persist a session with its build plan, advancing the step to ``plan``.
437
438    Upserts the session row by task id and returns the resulting record.
439
440    Args:
441        task_id: The Linear task identifier.
442        build_plan: The build plan markdown to store.
443        name: Optional display name for the session.
444        session_id: Optional opencode session id.

447    Returns:
448        Session: The saved session record.
449    """
450    now = datetime.now(UTC)
451    async with get_connection() as connection:
452        await connection.execute(
453            text(
454                """
455                INSERT INTO sessions (task_id, name, session_id, build_plan, posted_to_linear, step, project_id, user_id, run_attempts, listener_attempts, pr_link, linear_link, created_at, updated_at)
456                VALUES (:task_id, :name, :session_id, :build_plan, :posted_to_linear, :step, :project_id, :user_id, :run_attempts, :listener_attempts, :pr_link, :linear_link, :created_at, :updated_at)
457                ON CONFLICT (task_id) DO UPDATE SET
458                    name = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.name, ''), sessions.name),
459                    session_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.session_id, ''), sessions.session_id),
460                    build_plan = EXCLUDED.build_plan,
461                    step = EXCLUDED.step,
462                    project_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.project_id, sessions.project_id),
463                    user_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.user_id, sessions.user_id),
464                    linear_link = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.linear_link, sessions.linear_link),
465                    updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
466                """
467            ),
468            {
469                "task_id": task_id,
470                "name": name if name else "",
471                "session_id": session_id if session_id else "",
472                "build_plan": build_plan,
473                "posted_to_linear": False,
474                "step": "plan",
475                "project_id": None,
476                "user_id": None,
477                "run_attempts": 0,
478                "listener_attempts": 0,
479                "pr_link": None,
480                "linear_link": linear_link,
481                "created_at": now,
482                "updated_at": now,
483            },
484        )
485        await connection.commit()
486
487        result = await connection.execute(select(sessions).where(sessions.c.task_id == task_id))
488        row = result.fetchone()
489
490    if row:
491        return Session(
492            task_id=row.task_id,
493            name=row.name,
494            session_id=row.session_id,
495            build_plan=row.build_plan,
496            posted_to_linear=bool(row.posted_to_linear),
497            step=row.step or "initial",
498            project_id=row.project_id,
499            user_id=row.user_id,
500            run_attempts=row.run_attempts,
501            listener_attempts=row.listener_attempts,
502            pr_link=row.pr_link,
503            linear_link=row.linear_link,
504            created_at=row.created_at.isoformat(),
505            updated_at=row.updated_at.isoformat(),
506        )
507
508    return Session(
509        task_id=task_id,
510        name=name,
511        session_id=session_id,
512        build_plan=build_plan,
513        posted_to_linear=False,
514        step="plan",
515        project_id=None,
516        user_id=None,
517        run_attempts=0,
518        listener_attempts=0,
519        pr_link=None,
520        linear_link=linear_link,
521        created_at=now.isoformat(),
522        updated_at=now.isoformat(),
523    )

592async def get_sessions(user_id: str, step: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
593    """List sessions for a user, optionally filtered by current step.

595    Sessions are returned newest first.

async def save_oauth_token( service: str, access_token: str, refresh_token: str | None, expires_in: int) -> None: 
617async def save_oauth_token(service: str, access_token: str, refresh_token: str | None, expires_in: int) -> None:
618    """Store or refresh an OAuth access token for a service.
619
620    Args:
621        service: The service identifier, e.g. ``"linear"``.
622        access_token: The access token to store.
623        refresh_token: Optional refresh token for the service.
624        expires_in: Token lifetime in seconds from now.
625    """
626    expires_at = datetime.fromtimestamp(datetime.now(UTC).timestamp() + expires_in, tz=UTC)
627    async with get_connection() as connection:
628        if refresh_token is not None:
629            await connection.execute(
630                text(
631                    """
632                    INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (service, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at)
633                    VALUES (:service, :access_token, :refresh_token, :expires_at)
634                    ON CONFLICT (service) DO UPDATE SET
635                        access_token = EXCLUDED.access_token,
636                        refresh_token = EXCLUDED.refresh_token,
637                        expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
638                    """
639                ),
640                {
641                    "service": service,
642                    "access_token": access_token,
643                    "refresh_token": refresh_token,
644                    "expires_at": expires_at,
645                },
646            )
647        else:
648            await connection.execute(
649                text(
650                    """
651                    INSERT INTO oauth_tokens (service, access_token, expires_at)
652                    VALUES (:service, :access_token, :expires_at)
653                    ON CONFLICT (service) DO UPDATE SET
654                        access_token = EXCLUDED.access_token,
655                        expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
656                    """
657                ),
658                {
659                    "service": service,
660                    "access_token": access_token,
661                    "expires_at": expires_at,
662                },
663            )
664        await connection.commit()

Store or refresh an OAuth access token for a service.

Args: service: The service identifier, e.g. "linear". access_token: The access token to store. refresh_token: Optional refresh token for the service. expires_in: Token lifetime in seconds from now.

async def get_oauth_token(service: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None: 
667async def get_oauth_token(service: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
668    """Return a non-expired stored OAuth token for a service.
669
670    Args:
671        service: The service identifier.
672
673    Returns:
674        tuple[str, str] | None: The access token and its expiry timestamp, or
675            None when absent or expired.
676    """
677    async with get_connection() as connection:
678        result = await connection.execute(select(oauth_tokens).where(oauth_tokens.c.service == service))
679        row = result.fetchone()
680
681    if not row:
682        return None
683
684    expires_at = row.expires_at.timestamp()
685    if datetime.now(UTC).timestamp() < expires_at:
686        return row.access_token, str(expires_at)

Return a non-expired stored OAuth token for a service.

Args: service: The service identifier.

Returns: tuple[str, str] | None: The access token and its expiry timestamp, or None when absent or expired.

725async def record_session_history(
726    session_id: str,

733    cache_write_tokens: int | None = None,
734    context_tokens: int | None = None,
735    model: str | None = None,
736) -> SessionHistory:
737    """Record an opencode session's token usage at a workflow step.
738
739    Args:
740        session_id: The opencode session id.
741        step: The workflow step name.
742        length: Optional message length in characters.
743        input_tokens: Optional input token count.
744        output_tokens: Optional output token count.
745        reasoning_tokens: Optional reasoning token count.

748        context_tokens: Optional context window token count.
749        model: Optional model identifier.

751    Returns:

756    async with get_connection() as connection:
757        await connection.execute(
758            insert(session_history).values(
759                id=history_id,
760                session_id=session_id,
761                step=step,
762                length=length,
763                input_tokens=input_tokens,
764                output_tokens=output_tokens,
765                reasoning_tokens=reasoning_tokens,
766                cache_read_tokens=cache_read_tokens,
767                cache_write_tokens=cache_write_tokens,
768                context_tokens=context_tokens,
769                model=model,
770                created_at=now,
771            )
772        )
773        await connection.commit()
774
775    return SessionHistory(
776        id=history_id,
777        session_id=session_id,
778        step=step,
779        length=length,
780        input_tokens=input_tokens,
781        output_tokens=output_tokens,
782        reasoning_tokens=reasoning_tokens,
783        cache_read_tokens=cache_read_tokens,
784        cache_write_tokens=cache_write_tokens,
785        context_tokens=context_tokens,
786        model=model,
787        created_at=now.isoformat(),
788    )

1136async def update_waitlist_entry(
1137    entry_id: str,
1138    changes: WaitlistEntryUpdate,
1139    connection: AsyncSession | None = None,
1140) -> bool:
1141    """Apply a status transition to a waitlist entry by id.
1142
1143    ``updated_at`` is always bumped. Fields left as None on the update keep
1144    their current column value; ``clear_approval`` resets the approval
1145    metadata columns to NULL.
1146
1147    Args:
1148        entry_id: The waitlist entry id.
1149        changes: The status transition and column changes to apply.
1150        connection: An optional shared connection to run within; when omitted
1151            a new connection is opened and the change is committed.
1152
1153    Returns:
1154        bool: True when a row was updated, False when none matched.
1155    """
1156    values: dict = {"updated_at": datetime.now(UTC), "status": changes.status}
1157    if changes.approved_by is not None:
1158        values["approved_by"] = changes.approved_by
1159    if changes.approved_at is not None:
1160        values["approved_at"] = changes.approved_at
1161    if changes.notified_at is not None:
1162        values["notified_at"] = changes.notified_at
1163    if changes.joined_at is not None:
1164        values["joined_at"] = changes.joined_at
1165    if changes.clear_approval:
1166        values.update(approved_by=None, approved_at=None, notified_at=None, joined_at=None)
1167
1168    statement = (
1169        update(waitlist_entries)
1170        .where(waitlist_entries.c.id == entry_id)
1171        .values(**values)
1172        .returning(waitlist_entries.c.id)
1173    )
1174    if connection is None:
1175        async with get_connection() as conn:
1176            result = await conn.execute(statement)
1177            row = result.fetchone()
1178            await conn.commit()
1179        return row is not None
1180    result = await connection.execute(statement)
1181    row = result.fetchone()
1182    return row is not None

async def save_jwt_token(token: str, user_id: str, expires_at: str) -> None: 
1222async def save_jwt_token(token: str, user_id: str, expires_at: str) -> None:
1223    """Persist a JWT session record for a user.
1224
1225    The stored ``password_version`` is read from the user row at issuance, so
1226    any token minted before a password reset carries the old version and is
1227    rejected by :func:`verify_jwt_token` after the reset commits.
1228
1229    Args:
1230        token: The JWT to store.
1231        user_id: The user id the token belongs to.
1232        expires_at: ISO-8601 expiry timestamp.
1233
1234    Raises:
1235        RuntimeError: When no user row exists for the id.
1236    """
1237    now = datetime.now(UTC)
1238    expires_at_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(expires_at)
1239
1240    async with get_connection() as connection:
1241        version_result = await connection.execute(
1242            text("SELECT password_version FROM users WHERE id = :user_id"),
1243            {"user_id": user_id},
1244        )
1245        version_row = version_result.fetchone()
1246        if version_row is None:
1247            raise RuntimeError(f"User {user_id} not found while saving JWT session")
1248
1249        await connection.execute(
1250            text(
1251                """
1252                INSERT INTO jwt_tokens (token, user_id, expires_at, created_at, password_version)
1253                VALUES (:token, :user_id, :expires_at, :created_at, :password_version)
1254                ON CONFLICT (token) DO NOTHING
1255                """
1256            ),
1257            {
1258                "token": token,
1259                "user_id": user_id,
1260                "expires_at": expires_at_dt,
1261                "created_at": now,
1262                "password_version": version_row[0],
1263            },
1264        )
1265        await connection.commit()

Args: token: The JWT to store. user_id: The user id the token belongs to. expires_at: ISO-8601 expiry timestamp.

Raises: RuntimeError: When no user row exists for the id.

1330async def update_user_password(
1331    user_id: str,
1332    password_hash: str,
1333    connection: AsyncSession | None = None,
1334) -> None:
1335    """Replace the stored password hash for a user, invalidating prior sessions.
1336
1337    Bumps ``password_version`` so every JWT minted before the change is
1338    rejected by :func:`verify_jwt_token`.
1339
1340    Args:
1341        user_id: The user id.
1342        password_hash: The new password hash.
1343        connection: An optional shared connection to run within; when omitted
1344            a new connection is opened and the change is committed.
1345    """
1346    statement = (
1347        users.update()
1348        .where(users.c.id == user_id)
1349        .values(password_hash=password_hash, password_version=users.c.password_version + 1)
1350    )
1351    if connection is None:
1352        async with get_connection() as conn:
1353            await conn.execute(statement)
1354            await conn.commit()
1355        return
1356    await connection.execute(statement)

1483async def update_project(
1484    project_id: str,
1485    user_id: str,
1486    linear_project_id: str | None = None,
1487    name: str | None = None,
1488    repository_url: str | None = None,
1489    local_path: str | None = None,
1490    state: str | None = None,
1491) -> dict | None:
1492    """Update mutable fields of a user-scoped project.
1493
1494    Only non-None fields are updated; the record must belong to the given
1495    user.
1496
1497    Args:
1498        project_id: The project id.
1499        user_id: The owning user id.
1500        linear_project_id: Optional new Linear project link.
1501        name: Optional new project name.
1502        repository_url: Optional new repository URL.
1503        local_path: Optional new local checkout path.
1504        state: Optional new project state.
1505
1506    Returns:
1507        dict | None: The updated project row, or None when not found.
1508    """
1509    now = datetime.now(UTC)
1510    update_values: dict[str, datetime | str] = {"updated_at": now}
1511
1512    if linear_project_id is not None:
1513        update_values["linear_project_id"] = linear_project_id
1514
1515    if name is not None:
1516        update_values["name"] = name
1517
1518    if repository_url is not None:
1519        update_values["repository_url"] = repository_url
1520
1521    if local_path is not None:
1522        update_values["local_path"] = local_path
1523
1524    if state is not None:
1525        update_values["state"] = state
1526
1527    async with get_connection() as connection:

1542async def get_project_environments(project_id: str, user_id: str | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
1543    """Return the decrypted environment variables of a project.
1544
1545    Encrypted values are decrypted on read; failures yield an empty value.
1546    Only rows scoped to ``"project"`` are returned; user-shared rows are
1547    resolved separately via :func:`get_user_environments_decrypted`.
1548
1549    Args:
1550        project_id: The project id.
1551        user_id: Optional user id for ownership verification.
1552
1553    Returns:
1554        dict[str, str]: The environment as a key-value mapping.
1555
1556    Raises:
1557        LookupError: When a user is given and the project is not owned by them.
1558    """
1559    from demetra.services.persistence.encryption import decrypt_str
1560
1561    if user_id and not await get_project_by_id(project_id=project_id, user_id=user_id):
1562        raise LookupError("Project not found")
1563
1564    async with get_connection() as connection:
1565        result = await connection.execute(
1566            select(project_environments).where(
1567                (project_environments.c.project_id == project_id) & (project_environments.c.scope == "project")
1568            )
1569        )
1570        rows = result.fetchall()
1571
1572    env: dict[str, str] = {}
1573    for row in rows:
1574        if row.type == "encrypted":

async def upsert_project_environment( project_id: str, user_id: str, key: str, value: str, env_type: str = 'text', previous_key: str | None = None) -> dict: 
1727async def upsert_project_environment(
1728    project_id: str,
1729    user_id: str,
1730    key: str,
1731    value: str,
1732    env_type: str = "text",
1733    previous_key: str | None = None,
1734) -> dict:
1735    """Create or update a project environment variable.
1736
1737    Encrypted values are encrypted before storage. When ``value`` is blank
1738    the stored ciphertext of the row under ``key`` or ``previous_key`` is
1739    reused, so editing or renaming an encrypted variable without re-entering
1740    the secret preserves it. The row is scoped to ``"project"``.
1741
1742    Args:
1743        project_id: The project id.
1744        user_id: The owning user id for verification.
1745        key: The environment variable name.
1746        value: The environment variable value.
1747        env_type: ``"text"`` or ``"encrypted"``.
1748        previous_key: Optional prior key when renaming an existing entry.
1749
1750    Returns:
1751        dict: The created or updated entry with the value masked when
1752            encrypted.
1753
1754    Raises:
1755        LookupError: When the project is not owned by the user.
1756        RuntimeError: When the database returns no row.
1757    """
1758    from uuid import uuid4
1759
1760    from demetra.library.models import ENCRYPTED_VALUE_MASK
1761
1762    if not await get_project_by_id(project_id=project_id, user_id=user_id):
1763        raise LookupError("Project not found")
1764
1765    stored_value: str
1766    if env_type == "encrypted":
1767        stored_value = await _resolve_encrypted_env_value(
1768            key=key,
1769            value=value,
1770            previous_key=previous_key,
1771            owner_column=project_environments.c.project_id,
1772            owner_id=project_id,
1773            scope="project",
1774        )
1775    else:
1776        stored_value = value
1777
1778    async with get_transaction() as connection:
1779        result = await connection.execute(
1780            text(
1781                """
1782                INSERT INTO project_environment (id, project_id, key, value, type, scope)
1783                VALUES (:id, :project_id, :key, :value, :type, 'project')
1784                ON CONFLICT (project_id, key) WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET
1785                    value = EXCLUDED.value,
1786                    type = EXCLUDED.type
1787                RETURNING id, type
1788                """
1789            ),
1790            {
1791                "id": str(uuid4()),
1792                "project_id": project_id,
1793                "key": key,
1794                "value": stored_value,
1795                "type": env_type,
1796            },
1797        )
1798        row = result.fetchone()
1799        await _delete_previous_environment_key(
1800            connection=connection,
1801            owner_column=project_environments.c.project_id,
1802            owner_id=project_id,
1803            key=key,
1804            previous_key=previous_key,
1805            scope="project",
1806        )
1807
1808    if row is None:
1809        raise RuntimeError("Failed to insert project environment")
1810
1811    return {
1812        "id": row.id,
1813        "project_id": project_id,
1814        "key": key,
1815        "value": ENCRYPTED_VALUE_MASK if env_type == "encrypted" else value,
1816        "type": row.type,
1817    }

async def delete_session(task_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool: 
2053async def delete_session(task_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool:
2054    """Delete a user-scoped session and its log file.
2055
2056    Args:
2057        task_id: The Linear task identifier.
2058        user_id: The owning user id.
2059
2060    Returns:
2061        bool: True when the session existed and was deleted, otherwise False.
2062    """
2063    from demetra.settings import LOG_DIR
2064
2065    if not SAFE_TASK_ID_PATTERN.fullmatch(task_id):
2066        return False
2067
2068    async with get_connection() as connection:
2069        result = await connection.execute(
2070            delete(sessions)
2071            .where((sessions.c.task_id == task_id) & (sessions.c.user_id == user_id))
2072            .returning(sessions.c.task_id)
2073        )
2074        row = result.fetchone()
2075        await connection.commit()
2076        if not row:
2077            return False
2078
2079    sessions_log_dir = (LOG_DIR / "sessions").resolve()
2080    log_path = (sessions_log_dir / f"{task_id}.log").resolve()
2081    try:
2082        log_path.relative_to(sessions_log_dir)
2083    except ValueError:
2084        return True
2085
2086    if log_path.exists():
2087        try:
2088            log_path.unlink()
2089        except OSError:
2090            pass
2091
2092    return True
